$$
\begin{aligned}y & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{x}{2}+C) \\  & =\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{1}{2}(x+2C))\end{aligned}
$$

The factor $x+2C$ indicates that the graph of $y=\operatorname{tan}⁡(\frac{1}{2}(x+2C))$ is a horizontal translation of $y=tan\,(\frac{x}{2}).$ Comparing the two graphs below allows us to determine the amount of this shift.

$$
2C=\frac{\pi }{4}\,⟹\,C=\frac{\pi }{8}
$$
